note: Chapter-opening page (page_kind: chapter_opener), no printed folio. Two columns: narrow LEFT contents panel (four section entries 19.1-19.4, cyan italic, no tinted fill, one element) beside the opening prose in the RIGHT column. chapter_banner is a vertical gradient from yellow-green #d0e289 at the top fading to white by y~0.42; fill is sampled at the flat top interior. The 'CHAPTER 19' label (n=1) and the title (n=2) are set in blue small caps (serif-bold is the nearest allowed font). The bottom green strip (#cadf7f, y~0.956-1.0) carrying the '2024-25' reprint stamp is reported as footer_rule; the stamp is not a page number and is not reported. A diagonal 'not to be republished' watermark crosses the page and is ignored. body_text_size_px is the cap height of the opening prose in px of the 1700x2178 image; size_rel values are visual ratios. size_pt omitted: page DPI is not given. space_before is measured against the previous element in the same column.
